manualTestResults.by: Claude (delegated by user; automated browser walkthrough against the real back-end)
manualTestResults.notes: Real files in every state (completed, invalid rows, duplicate, cancelled). Counts, filters incl. local-day process dates, count links, details summary/history, byte-exact download, failure reasons, cancelled info, live update of a newly uploaded file, phone layout.

items: Show-filter chip reads "Showing cancelled" / "Showing active and cancelled" with a "Remove Show filter" button. Wording OK?
The processing stage for invalid rows is labelled "Waiting for corrections" on the file details screen. Wording OK?
Download failures other than a cancelled file or an unreachable back-end show the back-end message under the title "The file could not be downloaded". Wording OK?

When a live update or reload fails after a screen has loaded, the old data stays with a small "Couldn't refresh — showing earlier data" note and Retry (applies to the Dashboard, Transactions list and details pages).
